captured.controller_part_limits: 0..70C ambient,125C junction; 3.14..3.46V and0.92..0.98V. No industrial-temperature claim.
captured.regulator_enable: U11 pin6 POW_EXT_SWR now drives U13 EN, with existing47k pulldown. Pin4/5/7 are NC.

decoupling.reference_to_selected: Local3.3V analog2.2uF positions use22uF; local0.95V2.2uF positions use4.7uF;1uF positions use4.7uF;10uF positions use22uF. Pin15 retains22uF plus100nF after its bead.
decoupling.selected_4u7: CL10A475KA8NQNC C69335;25V,X5R,+/-10%,0603, mass production. This avoids choosing the NRND CL10A475KO8NNN series for new loads.

capacitance.limits: Typical Samsung DC-bias curves with 20% design allowance, nominal tolerance and X5R temperature loss. Estimates are not guaranteed production minima. Ripple, filter resonance and startup require hardware validation.

decoupling.application: Local bypass must be placed at its named physical pin. U12/U13 output banks remain at the regulators; their minimum compensation capacitance is independently sufficient. X5R local temperature must stay<=85C.
decoupling.PLL: FB670 BLM18PG330SN1D,33ohm at100MHz +/-25%,25mohm initial/50mohm after-tests DCR. Pin15 alone uses the filtered rail. At a conservative entire-IC3.3V current100mA, bead DC drop<=5mV using after-tests DCR; verify hot DC drop and ringing on hardware.
decoupling.PLL_footprint: Murata BLM18P reflow a=.7,b=2,c=d=.7mm. Sized for<=1.5A copper-land category; actual branch<=.1A. Do not claim full3A bead rating with these lands.

crystal.load: C685/C68620pF C0G +/-5%; nominal20/2+2pF estimated stray=12pF. The17ppm remaining budget cannot be proved from unknown motional capacitance/stray; tune after routing.
crystal.damping: R6710ohm initially, only on CKXTAL2 pin9 output per2024 reference. No resistor on CKXTAL1 pin10. Measure startup, drive,1.4V high/0.4V low limits with a low-loading method; select final damping from measured margin.
crystal.stock_substitution: Live search returns newer XL2EL89COI-111YLC-25M first, but C9006 exact old MPN still has113289 units. Do not silently substitute without checking its exact datasheet/lands.

required_high.LANWAKEB_pin2: R6774.7k toETH3.3; a LOW power-on latch enters test mode
required_high.CLKREQB_pin48: R6784.7k toETH3.3; open-drain request in both directions

straps.ISOLATEB: R6801k/R68115k from dedicatedEthernet3.3V; steady HIGH inS0, cold Ethernet off withS0. NoD3cold wake capability from a powered-off Ethernet rail.
straps.PERSTB: R67947k pulldown keeps controller in reset. Qualified hardware release and host gating remain to implement.
straps.logic_bounds: RTL Vih>=2.0V, Vil<=0.8V,Voh>=2.4V,Vol<=0.4V. TableIin<=0.5uA is specified atVDD/GND. A4.7k pull gives2.4mV endpoint-leak drop;47k pull gives23.7mV. Preserve latch states throughstartup; no other load may forceLANWAKE/GPI/LED1 low.
straps.POW_EXT_SWR: TI EN rising threshold max1.15V/falling min0.96V, endpoint leakage max150nA. RTL output levels provide DC voltage margin;47k adds<=75uA. Realtek omits test strapsR17/R18 forBG; this weaker pulldown terminates the unpowered/unsettled regulator input. Source output-current test conditions are not listed; verify startup waveform and LOW shutdown.

PCIe.mode: RK3568 MULTI_PHY2 PCIe2 RC x1 ->RTL8125BG EP, Gen2
PCIe.transmit_caps: C687/C688100nF0402 atU1W27/W28. C689/C690100nF0402 atU11HSOP38/HSON39. Exactlyone capacitor per transmitting leg.
PCIe.reference_clock: U1V24/V25 reference outputs connect directly toU11REFCLK44/45 as Rockchip HW Guide specifies; asynchronous powered-off behavior still requires sequencing qualification.
PCIe.host_controls: M1 group onVCCIO5=VCC3V3_S0: AD1PERST,AD7WAKE,AG6CLKREQ. WAKEn/CLKREQn must use their functional mux, not genericGPIO. These three balls and cross-domain isolation are not captured yet.
PCIe.layout: Rockchip recommends0201 ACcaps;0402 is provisional and must pass the final loss/return-loss budget and layout review. No stubs; pair length/impedance validation pending.

no_EEPROM_provisioning.basis: RealtekV1.5 section7.4 permits configuration defaults with EEPROM absent and OTP autoload bypassed. Capture explicitly selects3-wire93C46 and holds absent EEDO low.
no_EEPROM_provisioning.Linux_reviewed: 2026-09-10: RTL8125B XID0x641 ->MAC_VER63 and rtl_nic/rtl8125b-2.fw. rtl_init_mac_address prefers platform MAC, then device/register MAC, then random fallback; driver programs the active MAC.
no_EEPROM_provisioning.required_policy: Provision a stable, unique locally administered unicast MAC in each board image/config and apply before interface UP. Record it in the fixture ledger; verify persistence and no duplicates. Do not accept driver random fallback as production identity. Do not burn OTP.
no_EEPROM_provisioning.open: Confirm no-EEPROM/OTP-default behavior on the exact purchased silicon lot in bring-up; freeze a specific supported kernel/firmware/device-tree image and implement per-board MAC provisioning.

resolved_timing_interpretation.meaning: Figure16 spans successive rising edges ofPERSTB across a reset pulse. This is an inter-release interval, not a10ms analog edge slew.
resolved_timing_interpretation.still_required: Power stable>=100ms before release; reference stable>=100us; assertion>=100us; off/on>=50ms; internalPOR>=21ms aftercore valid. Hardware reset and brownout qualification are not implemented by pull resistors.

library_exceptions.F6.3: FB670 uses exact rectangular manufacturer reflow lands.
library_exceptions.F9.3: Project-local models; crystal native genericZscaled1.25 to0.8mm maxheight; bead intentionally shares identical BLM18P nominal geometry with the existing121-ohm variant. Body tolerances remain required in final clearance review.

open_work: Implement host PERST/WAKE/CLKREQ domain isolation, rail-valid delay and brownout sequencing; R679 currently prevents link startup.
Select and capture qualified2.5G four-pairPoE magnetics and connector, then terminate all8MDI endpoints and add portLEDs.
Finish simultaneous power/thermal budgets, PoE/USB-C/modem/IO circuitry.
Create, fully route and validate the integrated PCB and manufacturing outputs.
Perform prototype oscillator, reset, filter/ripple, PCIe and sustained Ethernet traffic tests.
